prompt: Draw a clean flat illustration of a display of these everyday objects, each object clearly separated as one solid block of colour. IMPORTANT COLOUR RULE: this is a TWO-COLOUR world -- you may use ONLY blue and white for the objects. EVERY single object must be painted either solid blue or solid white; no object may keep its real-world colour and no other colour (no red, yellow, orange, green, purple, etc.) may appear on any object. Paint each object as follows: the fire extinguisher must be blue; the school bus must be white; the stop sign must be blue; the sunflower must be white; the ladybird must be blue; the frog must be white; the basketball must be blue; the pineapple must be white; the chilli must be blue; the lime must be white. Include all of these objects: fire extinguisher, school bus, stop sign, sunflower, ladybird, frog, basketball, pineapple, chilli, lime. Do not label the objects and do not add any caption or text.
